title: observability-platform backend chart values
description: Only `config` is constrained here. The backend loads its settings through viper's AutomaticEnv with the OBS prefix, which reads ONLY the keys internal/config/config.go declares a default for: an OBS_* variable that matches nothing is not an error, it is silently ignored, so a typo leaves the operator watching default behavior while believing they changed something. Helm validates values against this schema before rendering, which turns that silence into an install-time error. tests/e2e/helm_test.go cross-references the key list below against config.go in both directions, so it cannot drift from the code.

config.description: Backend environment variables, rendered into the ConfigMap. Every key must be one internal/config/config.go declares.

OBS_HTTP_ADDR.$comment: Listed because it is a real config key, but templates/configmap.yaml rejects it with an actionable message: service.port owns the listen address, and setting both emits the key twice in one ConfigMap.

OBS_TARGET.$comment: A real config key, but templates/configmap.yaml rejects it: the chart decides each component's target.

OBS_INGESTER_URL.$comment: A real config key, but templates/configmap.yaml rejects it: the chart renders peer URLs from its own Services.

OBS_STORE_URL.$comment: A real config key, but templates/configmap.yaml rejects it: the chart renders peer URLs from its own Services.

OBS_QUERIER_URL.$comment: A real config key, but templates/configmap.yaml rejects it: the chart renders peer URLs from its own Services.

topology.description: all-in-one runs one StatefulSet; split runs the five Phase 6.1 components.

replicationFactor.description: How many distinct ingesters each write goes to; at most the ingesters the gateway writes to (split.ingester.writeReplicas, else replicas). Delivered to the gateway and querier only.

writeReplicas.description: How many of the replicas, from ordinal 0, the gateway writes to; the querier reads every replica. Unset means all of them. Lower it before adding an ingester's writes or before removing one (deployments/helm/README.md).

previous.description: For previews only (helm template cannot look up the live release): the replicas and writeReplicas the release currently runs. A real upgrade refuses it and reads them from the running gateway and querier Deployments.
